name: github-desktop-plus
description: External enhancement tool for GitHub Desktop — built with Electrobun + Vue 3

scripts.start: vite build && bun run build:hooks && electrobun dev
scripts.build:hooks: bun build src/hooks/index.ts --outdir=build/hooks --target=node --format=cjs --external electron && bun build src/hooks/preload/index.ts --outfile=build/hooks/preload/index.js --target=node --format=cjs --external electron && bun build src/hooks/preload/navbar.ts --outfile=build/hooks/preload/navbar.js --target=browser --format=iife && bun build src/hooks/preload/update-interceptor.ts --outfile=build/hooks/preload/update-interceptor.js --target=browser --format=iife && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.cpSync('locales','build/locales',{recursive:true})"
scripts.gdp:build: bun run build:hooks && cargo build --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml
scripts.gdp:dev: bun run build:hooks && cargo run --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -p gdp -- dev
scripts.build:canary: vite build && bun run build:hooks && electrobun build --env=canary
scripts.build:release: vite build && bun run build:hooks && electrobun build --env=release
